narrative.overview: A warm, premium Brazilian restaurant presentation that connects a real menu, Bahian cultural references and the feeling of a memorable meal.
keyCharacteristics: Cream paper and deep root-green contrast.
Saffron and terracotta as purposeful signals.
Editorial serif display paired with readable sans body copy.
Arched image frames and numbered sections.
Direct menu, WhatsApp and map actions.

rules.name: The Menu First Rule
rules.body: The current official menu is a primary action in the hero, header, menu section and final CTA.

rules.name: The Honest Preview Rule
rules.body: Show only confirmed public dish names, omit unconfirmed prices and link to the official menu for current availability.

rules.name: The Restrained Culture Rule
rules.body: Use cultural references as material, rhythm and atmosphere rather than as tourist decoration.

dos: Do lead with real supplied photography and the official menu action.
Do use saffron as a navigational signal.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion and mobile navigation.
donts: Don't invent a Google rating, review, price, award or menu item.
Don't copy the Pinterest reference or present it as a shipped asset.
Don't describe local compositions as new factual photographs.
